title: Veleda
lead: A woman prophet of the Bructeri, a German people, whom Tacitus says the Germans honored almost as a goddess in AD 69 to 70 after she foretold their success and the legions' end (Histories 4:61, 4:65). She is not in the Bible, which has its own prophetesses (Judges 4:4; Luke 2:36; Acts 21:9) and refuses worship of them.
